title: Sweep: worktree scope continuation (7 auditor prescriptions amortised)
summary: Worktree/lane-scope/continuation prescriptions: base capture, snapshot guards, scope reconciliation. Amortised from 7 content-hash carryoverTodos that were unreachable by any operator directive: their ids were 32-char hashes, so goal-text could never name them and triage could not prioritise them (all 144 were stamped priority=high, which is the same as none being high). Queue audit 2026-08-27. Member prescriptions verbatim below; work them as one sweep, smallest-blast-radius first, and retire the group when the theme is clean.

prescriptions.text: PRESCRIPTION: Require phase verification evidence to be cwd-independent: use git -C <worktree> or absolute paths, and assert the quoted rev-parse HEAD matches cycle-state.json worktree_base_sha before accepting a 'verified in this worktree' claim.
PRESCRIPTION: Gate TDD/Build dispatch on a non-empty triage top_n so a lane whose sole item is already resolved closes at triage instead of emitting no-work WARN reports.
PRESCRIPTION: Retire a fleet lane once its verifiableBy command exits 0 on HEAD: run the todo's verifiableBy before dispatch and drop the lane instead of dispatching a satisfied contract

PRESCRIPTION: Gate the no-rewrite skip on the reviewer's structured violation codes rather than on rr.Blocks > 0: skip only when every violation is one the contracted artifact's bytes determine (missing/empty artifact, missing section, non-canonical verdict, missing required key), and always fall through for location-class codes such as stray_in_worktree. Add a regression lock for 'unchanged hash, violation repaired elsewhere'.
PRESCRIPTION: Inject the git merge-base --is-ancestor <salvage-sha> HEAD result into the scout context block whenever continuation-manifest.json is present
PRESCRIPTION: Make coverage-gate declare an empty gate scope when no cycle commit exists instead of falling back to HEAD~1..HEAD.
PRESCRIPTION: Give a continuation lane its own selection record (id plus 'continuation of cycle-N') so triage-decision.json and build-report.md cannot disagree about what was built
